description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopFilterButton, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton. It provides functionality to render a filter button in a subpanel interface within the SuiteCRM application, including embedded scripts and localized labels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopFilterButton
classes.description: A widget class that renders a filter button in the subpanel interface, enabling users to show a search/filter panel.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the filter button HTML, including scripting and localized label, for display in the subpanel interface.
